_comment: Documented allowlist for migrations-consistency.mjs. Each exception is DURABLE (issue #19): the absolute rule forbids deleting orphan .sql or renumbering duplicate prefixes, so this drift is permanent and cannot be emptied — only reduced to documented exceptions. Every entry maps to an anchored section of docs/solutions/migrations-drift.md; the check FAILS if a reference does not resolve (missing file or missing anchor). Referenced form: { name: 'path/to/doc.md#anchor' }. The legacy array form (names only, no reference) is still parsed for back-compat but an active exception without a resolvable reference fails. Keys under 'allow' are migration directories relative to repo root.
